build_query_executor: build a ConnectionExecutor to wrap a database connection and enable query execution with Polars DataFrame conversion
execute_sql_query: execute a SQL query using ConnectionExecutor with options and validate that only SELECT queries are used for read operations
convert_result_to_dataframe: convert a database query result set to a Polars DataFrame using to_polars with optional batch iteration and schema overrides
fetch_arrow_data: fetch Arrow-native data from a database cursor using driver-specific properties from the Arrow driver registry
fetch_row_data_fallback: fetch database result rows incrementally with batch support as a fallback when Arrow-native fetching is not available
